stories.title: SBI narrows margin gap with HDFC Bank
stories.summary: State Bank of India has consistently narrowed the gap in net interest margins with HDFC Bank. Data shows the difference shrank from 106 basis points in fiscal year 2021 to 26 basis points by the second quarter of fiscal year 2027. The largest lender is catching up.

stories.title: Tata Chemicals reports loss on rising costs
stories.summary: Tata Chemicals reported a consolidated loss of 50 crore rupees for the quarter ended September 2026, down from a 154 crore rupee profit in the same period last year. The company cited higher energy and logistics costs alongside lower realisations. Revenue grew 8 per cent to 4,177 crore rupees.

stories.title: Tata Steel profit beats estimates
stories.summary: Tata Steel reported an 18 per cent year-on-year increase in consolidated net profit to 3,666.41 crore rupees for the September quarter, beating analyst estimates. The company also announced that Noel Naval Tata will retire as vice chairman on 11 November. A successor has not been named.

stories.title: Mahindra targets 12,000 monthly EV sales
stories.summary: Mahindra and Mahindra plans to increase electric SUV production to 12,000 units per month by March 2027. The company currently produces 8,000 units monthly with capacity fully utilised. The expansion aims to close the volume gap with market leader Tata Motors as five new models launch.

stories.title: Air purifier demand spikes as air quality worsens
stories.summary: Quick-commerce platforms including Blinkit and Zepto report a surge in air purifier sales as Delhi air quality enters the very poor category. Analysts attribute the demand to worsening pollution levels and the onset of winter. Seasonal appliance sales are also rising in Tier 2 cities.

stories.title: Auto retail sales drop 23 percent in October
stories.summary: Vehicle retail sales fell 23 per cent year-on-year to 3,172,466 units in October 2026. The Federation of Automobile Dealers Associations attributed the decline to a high base effect from last year, when Navratri and Diwali fell in the same month. This year, the festivals are split across months.

stories.title: Air India considers office space reduction
stories.summary: Air India is evaluating returning two towers at its Gurugram corporate office park to lower rental costs. The airline currently occupies four towers at the Vatika One on One campus. The move is part of a broader cost-saving programme that includes reviewing staff travel and department consolidation.

stories.title: Data Patterns profit falls 55 percent
stories.summary: Data Patterns reported a 55 per cent drop in net profit to 22 crore rupees for the quarter ended September 2026. Revenue fell 57 per cent to 133 crore rupees. The company described the period as a muted quarter following exceptionally strong execution in the same quarter last year.

stories.title: Foreign airlines protest Mumbai airport slot changes
stories.summary: Foreign airlines have asked the Civil Aviation Ministry to intervene after Mumbai airport denied summer 2027 slots. The airport plans to shift flights to Navi Mumbai. The Airline Operators Committee stated the decision was made without consultation and could disrupt network planning for international carriers.

stories.title: Markets prepare for Diwali Muhurat trading
stories.summary: The Indian stock market will hold a one-hour ceremonial Muhurat Trading session on 8 November 2026 from 2:20 PM to 3:30 PM. Data shows the Nifty 50 index has closed higher in 15 of the last 20 Muhurat sessions. Investors are watching to see if the streak continues.

stories.title: Stock markets hold ceremonial Diwali session
stories.summary: India’s stock markets will open for a special shortened session this Sunday to mark the Hindu new year, Samvat. The tradition of Muhurat trading persists despite the transition from handwritten ledgers to algorithms. The ceremonial session is intended to bring prosperity, though it arrives against a mixed market backdrop.

stories.title: Muhurat trading session set for Sunday
stories.summary: The BSE and NSE will conduct a one-hour Muhurat trading session on Sunday, November 8, from 2:20 pm to 3:30 pm. While the session is often marked by symbolic investments and lower volumes, benchmark indices have recorded gains in 12 of the last 15 years.

stories.title: Exchanges schedule special Sunday trading
stories.summary: The NSE and BSE will remain open for a special Diwali trading session on Sunday, November 8, from 2:05 pm to 3:30 pm. Markets will be closed on Tuesday for Diwali-Balipratipada. The Sunday session is a scheduled exception to the national holiday calendar.

stories.title: Coca-Cola India bottler files for IPO
stories.summary: Hindustan Coca-Cola Holdings has filed draft papers for an initial public offering consisting entirely of an offer for sale by its majority shareholder. The parent company plans to reduce its stake from 60 percent to approximately 45 percent. The company will receive no fresh capital.

stories.title: SoftBank sells 1.56 percent of Lenskart
stories.summary: SoftBank has sold a 1.56 percent stake in eyewear retailer Lenskart for 1,896 crore rupees through open market transactions. The shares were offloaded in 10 tranches at an average price of 697.15 rupees apiece. Goldman Sachs was the largest buyer in the deal.

stories.title: Sejal Glass announces 40.80 crore rupee acquisition
stories.summary: Sejal Glass Limited has approved the acquisition of the architectural and automotive glass business of Magnumtuff India Private Limited. The deal, which includes factory land and buildings, involves a lump-sum consideration of 40.80 crore rupees. The acquisition will be executed as a slump sale.

stories.title: Amber Enterprises arm files for 2,500 crore rupee IPO
stories.summary: IL JIN Electronics, a subsidiary of Amber Enterprises, has filed preliminary papers to raise 2,500 crore rupees through an initial public offering. The issue is entirely fresh equity, with proceeds earmarked for debt repayment and manufacturing equipment. No offer for sale component is included.

stories.title: MakeMyTrip enters ride-pooling with Quick Ride deal
stories.summary: MakeMyTrip has acquired a majority stake in Bengaluru-based shared mobility platform Quick Ride. The ride-pooling business has been transferred to a new entity, Co Ride Mobility Private Limited. Quick Ride’s promoters will continue to lead the business, which focuses on daily commutes for corporate employees.

stories.title: Temasek sells 4 percent of CarTrade Tech
stories.summary: Temasek has divested a 3.74 percent stake in CarTrade Tech for 470 crore rupees through an open market transaction. The shares were sold at an average price of 2,583 rupees. Following the sale, Temasek’s holding in the platform has decreased to 3.08 percent.

stories.title: QatarEnergy in talks for US LNG supply
stories.summary: QatarEnergy is in advanced negotiations to purchase up to 2 million metric tons of liquefied natural gas annually from NextDecade. The volumes would come from the proposed Train 6 at the Rio Grande export facility. NextDecade has not yet reached a final investment decision for the project.

stories.title: Marico to buy 51 percent of Bonorizon
stories.summary: Marico has agreed to acquire a 51 percent stake in Bonorizon Consumer Ventures for 35 crore rupees in an all-cash deal. The FMCG company will acquire the stake through primary subscription and retains the right to purchase the remaining equity after three years.

stories.title: Health insurance and pollution related illnesses
stories.summary: Health insurance may cover hospitalisation for respiratory conditions like asthma or bronchitis as pollution levels rise. Shrish Mahuli of SBI General Insurance notes that policyholders should not assume every pollution related medical expense is reimbursed. Coverage depends on the specific policy terms rather than the source of the illness.

stories.title: Prioritising debt over investments for bonus cash
stories.summary: Financial experts suggest using Diwali bonuses to clear credit card debt before starting mutual fund investments. Vedant Gupte of Trackk notes that card interest rates can exceed 36 percent annually. Paying off high interest debt provides a guaranteed return that no mutual fund can reliably promise to match.

stories.title: The hidden costs of no cost EMI offers
stories.summary: Shoppers using no cost EMI offers for festive purchases should check for processing fees, GST on interest and lost instant discounts. These plans can also impact credit limits and carry foreclosure charges. The term no cost refers to the interest, but not the total cost of the transaction.
